title: Module 5 Current — RandomForest vs Peers (Influx)
description:
RandomForest predicts **Module 5 current from peer modules 1–4,6–8 only** (not self-history).

| Series | Source |
|--------|--------|
| Actual | Influx `machine` + `_field` |
| Upper / Lower / Expected | Influx `ml_predictions` with tag **`model=peer_rf`** (from `bridge.py` peer backfill) |

Use the **dashboard** time picker only. Compare with the **vs. Peer Band** panel (±2σ Flux) on the same row.

Requires peer-RF backfill on the ML exporter (`ENABLE_PEER_RF_BACKFILL`).

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.machine == "2406-176021" and r._field == "Module5_Current_A")
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: "Module 5 (Actual)" }))

from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ml_predictions")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.machine == "2406-176021" and r.field == "Module5_Current_A" and r.model == "peer_rf")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "upper")
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 5m, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> fill(usePrevious: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: "Upper Bound (Peer RF)" }))

from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ml_predictions")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.machine == "2406-176021" and r.field == "Module5_Current_A" and r.model == "peer_rf")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "lower")
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 5m, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> fill(usePrevious: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: "Lower Bound (Peer RF)" }))

from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ml_predictions")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.machine == "2406-176021" and r.field == "Module5_Current_A" and r.model == "peer_rf")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "expected")
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 5m, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> fill(usePrevious: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: "Expected (Peer RF)" }))
